settings.content: An "Order by ... for Christmas delivery" note on product pages and the cart. It switches to the express date after the standard date and hides itself after the express date. Check Printful's holiday order deadlines each year: printful.com/holiday-order-deadlines

settings.content: PostHog records visits, clicks and session replays, and tracks product views, color/size picks, add to cart, checkout, searches, contact form sends and site errors. Paste the project API key from PostHog (Settings > Project > Project API key, starts with phc_). Leave blank to turn PostHog off.
